intro: Jordan's Ore Shipment is a crate of ore that Bailor Stonehand was to turn into his alloy for the smith Jordan Stilwell. Carried by caravan from the Wetlands, the delivery was intercepted and looted by Mo'grosh ogres in the northeastern hills of Loch Modan.

p: Meant to be refined by the dwarf Bailor Stonehand into his special alloy, this ore was originally promised to Jordan Stilwell for his metalwork. While crossing south through the mountains from the Wetlands into Loch Modan, the supply caravan was violently ambushed by the Mo'grosh ogres. The shipment was dragged into the ogres' wilderness stronghold, leaving the surviving guards to perish from their wounds and halting Jordan's smithing project until an adventurer can pry it back from the brutes.
